summary: Skip pytest governance for collect-only probes

delivery.outcome: The managed pytest governance bridge skips all gate and Git work for pytest --collect-only sessions while preserving fail-closed gate enforcement for sessions that execute tests.
nonGoals: Do not weaken governance for ordinary pytest sessions.
Do not change adopter-specific scan or IDE code.
Do not publish a release outside the material implementation change.

architecture.decision: Read pytest's collectonly option at the start of pytest_sessionstart and return before any gate or Git operation. Extend the managed shell fixture with a no-gate collect-only invocation and retain the existing ordinary and rejected-gate checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material commit and publish a subsequent corrective standard version.

validation.evidence: The no-gate collect-only fixture returns successfully.
Existing ordinary and negative gate fixture checks remain green.
Focused regression and managed governance gate pass.
